title: T1 Consolidate model boolean filters into one checklist multi-select
description: Replace the three independent Models boolean filter labels with one accessible checklist popover while preserving their exact URL and filtering semantics.
action: Add components/model-filter-picker.tsx using native details/summary and three labeled checkboxes named priced, active, and recent-open; checked priced/active emit 1, unchecked priced/active are omitted, and unchecked recent-open emits recent-open=0 through a hidden fallback. Integrate it into ModelsPage without carrying page, retaining q, ability, weights, valid sort/order, and cols.
implementation: Create server-renderable ModelFilterPicker with localized summary text, selected count, native checkbox labels, visible focus, viewport-bounded local overflow, and existing 44px coarse-pointer sizing.
Replace only the three page-level checkbox labels in ModelsPage; keep current-currency predicates before full-set sort and page slicing and keep AutoSubmitForm immediate submission.

Update focused E2E and accessibility scenarios after implementation for independent/combined query states, recent-open=0, page omission, retained q/ability/weights/sort/order/cols, keyboard operation, mobile overflow, and axe results.
convergence_criteria: [UI-observable] /models renders one checklist summary exposing independently operable priced, active, and recent-open options on desktop and mobile.
Changing an option from a URL containing page=2 removes page and retains q, ability, weights, sort, order, and cols.
Unchecked priced and active are absent from the query; unchecked recent-open produces recent-open=0.
Expanded picker has no document-level horizontal overflow and axe reports 0 serious or critical violations.
